Ariados

Bug Poison

Johto · Generation 2

Ariados is a Bug/Poison-type Long Leg Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 33.5 kg. It evolves from Spinarak. Its highest base stat is Attack (90), with a base stat total of 400.
